speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Oppositional Defiant Disorder (ODD). The patient exhibits a persistent pattern of angry/irritable mood, argumentative/defiant behavior, and vindictiveness (e.g., refusing to participate, "You're not the boss of me"), which distinguishes this from simple disobedience.
